description: Worm-track back, white-edged fins. Tucks along the slow far edge of the pool and strikes fast.
Red slash under the jaw. Holds in the riffle and rises slow and deliberate, so don't rush the set.
The desert-side rainbow of Eastern Oregon. Holds in the slack water behind the boulder at the head of the pool, darting out to sip mayflies drifting down the seams.
